description: Asks what CDate returns for text in many shapes (time only, ISO with and without time, month-name forms, a compact eight-digit form, two-digit years at 29/30 and 49/50, year 100, AM/PM, an out-of-range hour) and for numbers, numeric text, empty text, Null and True. Results depend on the oracle's locale and calendar, which are recorded. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
